gpu_tip: ~105GB total at 128K context. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 5070 Ti) handles the always-on layers, and ~128GB of DDR5 system RAM covers the offloaded MXFP4 experts — llama.cpp's native MXFP4 support keeps this close to a full-VRAM fit.
mac_tip: Needs ~105GB — fits a 128GB MacBook Pro (M4 Max or M5 Max) comfortably.
